evidence.snippet: Yes. The 14-day free trial gives you 100K API credits across all six API endpoints, as well as  MCP server access.
Instantly. Your API key is issued immediately after payment. If you are on a free trial, you’ll get an API key once you confirm your email.

decisions.reason: Pages explicitly describe a self-serve 14-day free trial that issues an API key after email confirmation, with continued use requiring a paid Wallet/annual plan.
